title: form_handler.gleam is 835 lines against the <200-line logic-module target and mixes four concerns
evidence: AGENTS.md: "Target: <200 lines for logic modules, <400 lines for view modules." Spec decision 1: "reference_checks/form_handler.gleam (HTTP: classify -> dispatch, handlers stay thin)". wc: "835 src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam". Function map (grep): "265:pub fn handle_answer_post( ... 374:pub fn handle_answer_put( ... 463:pub fn handle_resend( ... 638:fn audit_resend( ... 742:pub fn format_annual_salary(monthly_cents: Int) -> String { ... 747:fn thousands_separated(digits: String) -> String {"
detail: The HTTP handler also owns the full resend business flow (remint, outcome evaluation, rollback, effective-contact send, audit, ~217 lines) plus copy/format helpers (format_annual_salary, thousands_separated, group_every_three). Resend-policy or formatting changes churn the router-facing module; the handler is not "thin" as the spec declared.
recommended_fix: Extract the resend orchestration (resend_fresh_link, any_delivered, resend_audit_details, rollback_remint, send_invite_to_effective_contact, effective, audit_resend) into a reference_checks/resend.gleam module, and move salary formatting to form_copy, keeping the handler under the 200-line target.

title: is_answer_timing_suspicious duplicates application_handler.is_timing_suspicious with only the floor constant changed
evidence: form_handler.gleam:822-835: "pub fn is_answer_timing_suspicious(values: List(#(String, String))) -> Bool { case get_value(values, "_form_loaded_at") { "" -> True loaded_at_str -> { case int.parse(loaded_at_str) { Error(_) -> True Ok(loaded_at_ms) -> { let delta_ms = form_view.current_unix_ms() - loaded_at_ms delta_ms < 500 || delta_ms > 604_800_000 } } } } }". application_handler.gleam:256-269 is identical with "delta_ms < 2000". form_handler.gleam:474 uses the shared helper for resend: "|| application_handler.is_timing_suspicious(values)". AGENTS.md: "DRY: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places."
detail: Two copies of the same fail-closed timing branches (missing, unparseable, future, >7d) differing only in the 500/2000ms floor, both used inside the same file. If /apply evolves the branches (upper bound, parse behaviour), the answer path drifts silently. Spec decision 12 flagged this exact fork for Perkins.
recommended_fix: Add a min_ms parameter to application_handler.is_timing_suspicious (default 2000) and call it from the answer POST/PUT paths with 500; delete is_answer_timing_suspicious, keeping the 500ms floor covered by the existing unit tests.
